svg.title: Video Template I BPM workflow — Documentary
svg.desc: Seven-phase governed video production BPM workflow for Documentary. It shows greenlight, pre-production, production, post, release review, distribution, post-launch learning, quality gates, typed artifacts, principal agents, targeted rework, and fail-closed runtime status.
svg.metadata: Generated from spec/production_scale_framework.md. Visual system follows ui/public/svg/video.workflow.svg. Evidence basis: Detailed S6 flow; S3-light and S4/S5 variants are explicit scale exceptions/overlays. Runtime remains fail-closed; capability maps do not activate tools, network, or production.

g.aria-label: Workflow title, profile and runtime status
g.text: Video Template I · Documentary BPM Workflow
Shared seven-phase production skeleton · specialized tasks, crew, gates, handoffs and feedback
FAIL-CLOSED — This workflow is a capability/scheduling design. It does not activate network, tools, providers or production without separate host and human gates.
Scale is selected before archetype. Typed handoffs carry correlation, evidence, quality, rights and HiTL state.
Build a source-grounded documentary through archive research,
continuous fact checking, ethical review and corrections.
Explained episodes, historical/scientific series, docuseries and
S3-light and S4/S5 variants are explicit scale
Strict factual L2; dual legal/ethics clearance; continuous fact
mesh; mandatory post-launch corrections at S6.
Host-owned orchestration, evidence, memory and approvals span all seven phases.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Start research track before full greenlight.
• Define thesis, subjects, territories and sources.
• Approve budget, rights and portrayal ethics.
• Dual clearance: rights plus ethical portrayal.
Research brief · budget · rights · ethics record
Revise thesis, rights or portrayal plan.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Web and archive research build SourceCatalog.
• L1 requires source traceability and treatment scope.
• Archive assets carry rights and provenance.
Return unsupported claim or unclear source.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Capture interviews, scenes and contextual visuals.
• Targeted pickup replaces only failed material.
Pickup, reclear or correct failed evidence.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Complete color, sound, captions and localization.
• Keep citations and archive lineage attached.
• No edit may detach a claim from evidence.
Documentary master · stems · captions · source map
Fix edit, context, audio or localization defect.
PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Unresolved factual or portrayal risk blocks.
Route factual, legal or ethical note to owner.
PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Package channel, SEO and multilingual assets.
• Create preservation master and source archive.
• Carry territorial rights to each endpoint.
• Every outlet validates rights and metadata.
• Archive integrity is mandatory for S6.
Repackage or reclear only failed endpoint.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Monitor audience response and factual challenges.
• Corrections are mandatory in the S6 overlay.
Feed validated findings into future research.
HANDOFF CONTRACT — correlation_id · from/to agent · artifact_ref/type · scale · archetype · evidence_refs · L1/L2 · rights_state · needs_hitl
Offline/UAT runs also emit knowledge_usage. Crew lists are capability maps; host policy remains authoritative.
Evidence basis: Detailed S6 flow; S3-light and S4/S5 variants are explicit scale exceptions/overlays.
Principal unique agents linked in this diagram: 34 · Seven phases · fail-closed runtime · no automatic scale promotion.
